cards.title: Your prescriptions are not a product
cards.body: Health data is personal. Before asking anyone to scan a prescription, AICA wants to be clear about what it will and won't do.

cards.title: Never sold. Full stop.
cards.body: AICA will never sell your data. Not to advertisers, not to anyone. It's a founding rule, not a fine-print promise.

cards.title: Nothing without consent
cards.body: Consent is asked at sign-up. You know what you're agreeing to before anything is stored.

cards.title: Nothing saved without your check
cards.body: When AI reads a prescription, you confirm it against the photo before it's saved. The AI doesn't write into your records on its own.

cards.title: Your data, your exit
cards.body: You can download your data or delete it. If AICA isn't for you, take your records with you or remove them.

cards.title: Built with India's rules in mind
cards.body: India's DPDP Act gives people rights over personal data, like consent, access, correction and erasure. AICA is being designed around those ideas from the start.

cards.title: Trust is the whole product
cards.body: Never sold, consent first, you confirm, download or delete anytime. Read more and join the waitlist at aicaglobal.in.

takeaway: AICA never sells your data, asks consent at sign-up, saves nothing unconfirmed, and lets you download or delete it.
share: AICA's data promise: never sold, consent first, download or delete anytime.
